items.q: What does the beautician course include?
items.a: The course covers 15 modules: skin science, facials, threading, waxing, bleaching, de-tan, clean-ups, body polishing, body wraps, manicure, pedicure, eyelash and brow enhancement, product knowledge, salon management, hygiene and practical assessment.

Yes. Roughly 70% of every module is practical. You will work on training mannequins, peer practice and supervised live-client sessions inside our in-academy studio. Real practice is non-negotiable in beautician training.

Graduates receive the Master Beauty Academy Professional Beautician Certificate after passing both written and practical assessments. The certificate showcases your training scope and is recognised by salon employers across India.

Yes. We cap batches at 12 students. Smaller batches mean more one-on-one time with trainers, more practice slots and faster mastery — especially for technique-heavy modules like facials and threading.

items.q: Can I open my own salon after this course?
items.a: Yes — the course is designed to make you both technically and operationally salon-ready. Modules 12 and 13 specifically cover client consultation, hygiene, billing, social-media marketing and basic business operations.

items.q: Is the course recognised by the government?
items.a: The Master Beauty Academy certificate is an industry-recognised vocational credential. Recognition from salon employers and successful graduate placements are the most meaningful measures of certificate value.
